name: cmd_faces_detect
description: Detect Faces (command `faces.detect`). Params: {ids?, apply?: bool (default true), score?: 0.6, nmsIou?: 0.3, maxFaces?} → {photos: [{id, faces: [{rect, score, landmarks}]}]}. Finds faces with the YuNet detector (download it first: `faces.models.download {id: "yunet-2023mar"}`) and, unless `apply` is false, adds them as unnamed face regions (one undo step), replacing earlier detections but never regions from XMP or ones you named; the sidecar is not touched. Menu: Photo.
